services.name: Go Skydiving
services.desc: Wondering how to get into skydiving? Tandem skydiving is not only the perfect introduction to the sport, but it’s also available to most everyone! If you are at least 18 years old and meet the physical requirements of skydiving, you can make a tandem jump after only a brief training session - no experience necessary! And it’s not just a crazy fun adventure … it’s supremely empowering. Conveniently located within easy reach of Cincinnati, Louisville, and Indianapolis, Start Skydiving is the top destination for tandem skydiving in Indiana, Ohio, and Kentucky.
